issues: No integrity issues: no seeding, file access, test-image use or state carried between runs. resize starts as None in each new loader and is set inside the timed train().
The untimed first call compiles both the 24 px and 32 px shapes. That is allowed compile-only carry-over, and the incumbent already switched shapes (28 px, then 32 px) the same way.
MaxPool2d(3) -> AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) is correct and needed: a 24 px input leaves a 2x2 final map, and at 32 px (3x3 map) both layers give the same output.
The switch to 32 px is checked once per epoch, at the start, so the 1/3 boundary is rounded to whole epochs. This only affects exact timing.
